Mobile Application Developer - Nghỉ T7, CN

  • Mức lương: Thỏa thuận
  • Địa điểm: Hồ Chí Minh
  • Kinh nghiệm: 1 - 2 năm
  • Bằng cấp: Đại Học trở lên

Chi Tiết Công Việc

Mô tả công việc:

  • We are looking for Vue React Frontend Developer to:
  • Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native for Android and iOS.
  • Develop new features and enhance existing functionality based on business requirements.
  • Understand and maintain existing application architecture, business logic, and application flows.
  • Integrate RESTful APIs and handle data, authentication, and error handling.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application, build, and production issues.
  • Work with Kotlin/Java for Android and Swift for iOS when required.
  • Maintain and integrate third-party libraries, SDKs, and native modules.
  • Use Git/Git Flow and follow development and code review practices.
  • Build, test, and deploy applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
  • Upgrade library version if needed

Yêu cầu công việc:

  • Bachelor’s degree in software engineer, computer science or a related technical field.
  • 1-2 years of hands-on experience in mobile application development using React Native.
  • Strong knowledge of React, React Native, Java.
  • Strong understanding of the fundamentals of iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin/Java), including application lifecycle, memory management, and asynchronous programming.
  • Understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle, from development and testing to deployment.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, responsive UI development, and UI/UX principles.
  • Experience developing and maintaining applications for both Android and iOS.
  • Experience with Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect for mobile application deployment and release.
  • Experience with RESTful APIs and mobile-to-backend integration.
  • Experience with Git and Git Flow.
  • Experience using AI coding tools, coding agents.
  • Ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin/Java for Android and Swift for iOS is a strong advantage.

Quyền lợi được hưởng:

  • Attractive salary.
  • Probation period is 2 months, probation salary is 85% of the total salary. After the probation period, if hired as an official employee, the Company will pay the remaining 15% of the total salary during the probation period.
  • Full contribution to social insurances.
  • 13th-month bonus.
  • Premium private insurances coverage.
  • Personal Development plan and budget for learning and development courses, so you can always upgrade your skills and knowledge.
  • Modern laptops.
  • Free food, bonding activities such as gaming time, meal time, team building events, and more.
  • Open, friendly and positive work environment.
